intent: Reduced, reference-backed Star Trip world kit. Every generated model maps to an object or scene type explicitly found in public A Short Hike screenshot pages, except the rocket and communication tower, which use public NASA/Wikimedia references and are modeled with A Short Hike-level low-poly density.
legalBoundary: Use screenshots and public-domain references for visual study only. Do not extract, copy, or reproduce protected A Short Hike assets, textures, map layouts, characters, or unique object arrangements.

requirements.scope: Only assets with an explicit found reference object are generated.
requirements.modelingRule: Fewer assets, more parts per model. Each model should read as finished low-poly game art before pixelation, not a primitive placeholder.
